source: Fresh author-created scenarios, one response per arm; not a benchmark superiority claim.

A: Retains a simple existing PostgreSQL/cron design absent a demonstrated unmet requirement.
Evaluates duplicate harm and team operating burden instead of universally requiring dedupe/locks.
Names proportionate observable failure handling without asserting an unprovided mechanism is mandatory.
Gives measurable workload/reliability/product triggers for revisiting the design.
Separates supplied measurements from unknown restore/reliability evidence.
B: Shows both regions confirming the last seat during a partition violates no-oversell.
Explains convergence/LWW cannot preserve already-issued confirmations.
Explains quorum/coordination cannot guarantee immediate acceptance on both sides through arbitrary partitions.
Offers realistic coordinated ownership, preallocated rights, or provisional acceptance choices with limitations.
Requires explicit product tradeoff rather than silently weakening an invariant or promising impossible availability.
C: Uses effective-dated historical tariffs at measurement event time, retaining correction/replay history.
Handles specified 48-hour lateness without silently discarding billable events; addresses completeness/late corrections.
Aligns business dedupe identity and retention with 90-day replay and in-flight deliveries; uses sink constraints appropriately.
Recognizes calculation-version uniqueness alone can double bill across versions; proposes controlled replacement/reconciliation/deltas.
Provides recoverable staged recalculation/publication and verification of crash/replay/late-event outcomes.
D: Traces deletion through search/vector copies, archives, training derivatives and backups.
Preserves deletion knowledge outside rolled-back restore state and reapplies it before exposing/rebuilding restored data.
Addresses asynchronous deletion visibility/access controls and observable completion/failure recovery.
Distinguishes policy/retention/model-remediation choices from established engineering guarantees.
Does not claim legal compliance and identifies missing legal/business retention decisions.

separate_traceability: Record actual supporting references and retrieval use separately; do not penalize baseline for lacking source access.
